patch_resolves_note: The authoritative `-fix` image is clean, but it does not reach `SVCDSubRenderImage()` on the original witness. The later fixed tree adds an early empty-URL rejection in `src/input/demux.c`, so `demux_NewAdvanced()` returns before the demux/decoder pipeline can enter the SVCD subtitle renderer; the staged `patch.diff` remains unrelated to `modules/codec/svcdsub.c`.

nodes.state: At the crashing zero-color run, the `memset()` sink's exclusive write end is 24577 while the allocated Y-plane extent is 24576 bytes, so the third byte of the 3-pixel write lands one byte past the heap allocation.

edges.relation: The zero-run write span computed immediately after the clamp (`i_count + 1`) is passed unchanged as the third argument of the following `memset()` sink.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: When the zero-color RLE branch is taken, the number of pixels written by the following `memset()` (`i_count + 1`) must not exceed the pixels remaining in the current row (`p_sys->i_width - i_column`).
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable clamp clips `i_count` against the full remaining pixel count even though the sink writes `i_count + 1` bytes. On the witnessed path the clamp leaves `i_count` at 2 while only 2 pixels remain, so the next write still spans 3 bytes.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: Not runtime-verified on the authoritative fixed original case: the `-fix` image stays clean by rejecting the empty demux URL in `demux_NewAdvanced()` before the SVCD decoder path is entered, so `zero_run_clamp` is `not_exercised` there and no PoC-only perturbation can change that input-independent guard.
